profile.name: RPLIDAR激光雷达
profile.description: 用于机器人环境感知的二维激光雷达。该设备通过连续扫描获取距离与角度测量数据，可用于避障、定位、建图和周围环境轮廓检测。
profile.description_en: A 2D LiDAR sensor for robot environment perception. It continuously scans to acquire distance and angle measurements, enabling obstacle avoidance, localization, mapping, and surrounding scene detection.

registry.name: SLAMTEC Adapted from https://github.com/Ezward/rplidar
registry.description: RP Lidar是由SLAMTEC生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、扫描、绘图、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, angle in bounds等操作。
